items.title: Amazon (AMZN) Has Its First Binding Union Contract In North America
items.summary: Amazon.com (NasdaqGS:AMZN) warehouse workers in Canada have secured the company's first binding union contract in North America. The collective agreement follows a labor board ruling that found Amazon used anti union tactics during the organizing effort. The contract covers hundreds of employees, setting out wage terms and added protections after regulator intervention in the bargaining process.
